mechanism: Amiodarone contains high iodine content that can worsen hyperthyroidism and antagonize propylthiouracil's therapeutic effect, while propylthiouracil may increase amiodarone's arrhythmogenic potential through thyroid dysfunction.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use alternative antiarrhythmic and monitor thyroid function (TSH, free T4) closely every 2-4 weeks and cardiac rhythm continuously.
